answerNotes.CAMELLIA: Camellia includes several species and many varieties; flowering time is not the same for every kind.
answerNotes.EVERGREEN: Evergreen describes foliage retention, not a promise of flowers throughout the year.

answerNotes.SEPAL: Sepals form the calyx, outside the petals; the names identify different flower parts.
answerNotes.SHRUB: A shrub describes a growth form rather than one exact maximum height.
